json.question: What should I do if it rains after spraying?

body.answer: Rain-fastness (guidance): contact fungicides need roughly 8-24 hours without rain after spraying, systemic ones about 1-2 hours; mancozeb needs at least about 4 hours.

citations.source: Purdue Vegetable Crops Hotline 2021; NC State Apple Alert 2018

text.en: Rain-fastness (guidance): contact fungicides need roughly 8-24 hours without rain after spraying, systemic ones about 1-2 hours; mancozeb needs at least about 4 hours.
